descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Telecomunicații
How would you like to work in IT, toying with cutting edge technologies and enjoying your life? At Orange Services, it’s possible!
 As one of the largest IT Hub within Orange Group, we are working internationally for both Orange corporate functions and country operations. Through a unique combination of know-how and expertise, our teams provide a broad range of IT & Business Solutions.
 Come closer to #LifeAtOrange!
 What we’re looking for 
 We are seeking a candidate with solid experience in IT security, particularly in managing and securing Microsoft 365 environments, including Teams, Exchange, and SharePoint. Knowledge of identity and access management, such as Azure AD and MFA, as well as a good understanding of security standards and regulations like NIS2, GDPR, and ISO 27001, is essential. The ideal candidate has experience in risk assessment, security audits, vulnerability analysis, and implementing security and compliance policies. Strong communication and collaboration skills are important, along with an analytical and rigorous approach to risk management.
 What you’ll be doing 
You will be part of Orange Innovation Romania department and you will have the opportunity to work transversally with various interlocutors, internally and within the Group, for a wide variety of projects (IT, Cloud, Data&AI, Business Intelligence, IoT,..)
You will help ensure an optimal level of security for IT solutions and services intended for the Group's entities and countries, while coordinating with a network of Security Managers and security referents. You will also contribute to defining security requirements and securing building blocks within the framework of NIS2 regulatory requirements.
You will ensure the security of environments within the group by analyzing risks and implementing appropriate solutions.
Contribute to security audits and ensure system compliance with applicable standards and regulations.
Collaborate with IT and security teams to design secure and robust architectures.
Participate in technological watch and continuous improvement of security measures.
Support teams in managing security incidents.
Support the operational teams of the IT Group in securing Microsoft collaborative solutions, bringing your expertise to guarantee data protection and compliance of environments used across the Group.
Work closely with security architects, auditors, and risk analysis experts to design and strengthen secure solutions adapted to the Group's challenges.
 What you need to know/have 
You have advanced experience in securing Microsoft collaborative solutions and messaging, demonstrating your deep mastery of Microsoft 365 environments and their security challenges.
Mastery of Microsoft 365 solutions, including Teams, Exchange, and SharePoint.
Expertise in identity and access management (Azure AD, MFA, etc.).
Knowledge of security standards and regulations (NIS2, GDPR, ISO 27001).
Knowledge of IT technologies
Knowledge of computer security good practices: ISO2700x, NIST, CIS, etc.
Experience with security risk assessment, g. ISO27005 or EBIOS Risk Manager methodology
Familiarity with Cyber Threat Intelligence & Vulnerability Management
Awareness with European and international regulations, such as NIS 2, CRA, and GDPR
Skills in auditing and vulnerability analysis
Experience in implementing security and compliance policies.
You demonstrate excellent communication skills to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams. Your rigor and analytical mindset allow you to anticipate risks and propose relevant solutions. You are also recognized for your ability to work in a team, your adaptability to technological changes, and your curiosity that drives you to continuously learn and improve.
 What’s in it for you 
Performance Bonuses – based on your results & the company’s
Electronic Meal Tickets
Medical & Life insurance for you - facilities for your family, too
Professional GSM subscription
Personal GSM subscription, also [because we believe in communication!]
Special grants on Smartphones & devices; discounts for Orange products & services
Development Platforms - Orange Learning, Trainings, Career Counselling, Coaching & Career plan mentoring
Wellbeing Programs – we support your Zen
 Orange Services is about bringing together people and technology.
 Come & work for a #TopEmployer company. You could be part of an organization where great colleagues and team spirit support your professional development.
 At Orange, you can.
 We encourage all candidate profiles, regardless of gender, age, race, citizenship, ethnicity, color, language, religion, social origin, genetic traits, sexual orientation, permanent or temporary disability, nationality, political choice, social category or social origins, situation or family responsibility, belonging to a disadvantaged category, membership or trade union activity.
